notes.title: Update! Patch notes: Your Seeds Are Safe Now
notes.content:
[p][b]Patch Notes - Update Ver. 0.0469 (Don't ask)

[/b]Thanks a lot for all your feedback and reports! it really helps us make the game better![b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the resource colors would reset after closing and reopening the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where prices were incorrectly calculated when purchasing 10 or 50 items at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where house objects wouldn't appear until the house tab was clicked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused special mushrooms and flowers to spawn increasingly more frequently over time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added seed cost display to the tooltip when hovering over house upgrade buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the seed value earned per click to the UI.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you like what we're doing or you are curious about our future, slap that wishlist button, it helps more than you think. Thanks for all the love![/p]
